flows.name: Butter signs, Revu opens
flows.signedRevisionPolicy: Revu must open the new signed output without replacing the source.

flows.name: Revu markup, Butter imports
flows.signedRevisionPolicy: Butter must preserve imported Revu markup and write any signed result as a new file.

flows.name: Butter signs, Revu reviews, Butter reopens
flows.signedRevisionPolicy: The original signed bytes remain unchanged across the review round trip.

flows.name: Revu reviews, Butter signs, Revu reopens
flows.signedRevisionPolicy: The Butter output is a distinct Save As result accepted by the exact Revu version.

flows.name: Alternating countersignatures starting in Butter
flows.signedRevisionPolicy: Each signer appends an independently inspected revision; no signer overwrites prior signed bytes.

flows.name: Alternating countersignatures starting in Revu
flows.signedRevisionPolicy: Every appended signature is correlated to its source revision and independently postvalidated.

flows.name: Safe-save rejection and recovery
flows.signedRevisionPolicy: Cancellation, collision, race, prohibited-change, or postvalidation failure preserves the source and publishes no replacement.

flows.name: Independent oracle and evidence availability
flows.signedRevisionPolicy: Unavailable or unrun oracle evidence is recorded explicitly and cannot be promoted to cryptographic validity.
